title: Minimize Maximum of Array
summary: Given an array of non-negative integers, you can perform operations to decrease any element by 1 and increase the previous element by 1.
statement: Given an array of non-negative integers, you can perform operations to decrease any element by 1 and increase the previous element by 1. The goal is to minimize the maximum value in the array after any number of operations.
constraints: An operation moves one unit from index i to index i-1 for any i greater than zero.
Apply any number of operations and minimize the largest array value.
hints: For each prefix ending at i, its total can move only within that prefix or farther left.
Therefore its average rounded up is a lower bound on the final maximum.
Take the largest ceiling prefix average.
That maximum provides enough capacity across every prefix to redistribute excess leftward, so the strongest lower bound is also achievable.
editorial: That maximum provides enough capacity across every prefix to redistribute excess leftward, so the strongest lower bound is also achievable.

tests.explanation: The first two values total ten, forcing a maximum of at least five; all prefixes fit under five per position, so five is achievable.
No operation can move mass rightward away from the initial ten, so the answer remains ten.
